enum.name: SFHACK_ACOUSTIC_SOURCE
enum.description: What an acoustic bearing points at (the base tells them apart by their rotor sound).

entry.name: SFHACK_ACOUSTIC_SOURCE_OWN_DRONE
entry.description: Our own drone (position fix from the base).

enum.name: SFHACK_TRACKER_STATE
enum.description: Onboard tracker state when an enemy report was made.

message.name: ACOUSTIC_BEARING
message.description: Direction of a sound source measured by the base's microphone array (UMA-16), base to drone, ~1 Hz.
message.field: Compass bearing from the array, 0 = north, clockwise.
Elevation above the horizon. NaN if unknown.
1-sigma of the elevation. NaN if unknown.
Microphone array id (several arrays per base).

message.name: TRACK_REPORT_INFO
message.description: Bookkeeping of one buffered enemy report, drone to base. Sent right before the report's CAMERA_TRACKING_GEO_STATUS (and its image, if any); the base acknowledges the complete report with TRACK_REPORT_ACK.
message.field: When the report was made (drone clock).
Our drone's estimated position when the report was made.
Our drone's estimated position when the report was made.
Our drone's estimated altitude (AMSL) when the report was made.
Target height above the onboard terrain map.
Size of the JPEG snapshot that follows (DATA_TRANSMISSION_HANDSHAKE + ENCAPSULATED_DATA), 0 = none.

message.name: TRACK_REPORT_ACK
message.description: The base received enemy report report_seq completely (base to drone); the drone drops it from its resend buffer.
